description: This is a Java test class file that contains unit tests for the RequireVoidReasonVoidHandler class. The tests verify that certain void operations throw exceptions when void reasons are invalid (null, empty, or blank) and do not throw exceptions when void reasons are valid or null for unsupported types.

classes.name: RequireVoidReasonVoidHandlerTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class extending BaseContextSensitiveTest, containing tests for the RequireVoidReasonVoidHandler class to ensure proper exception handling when void reasons are invalid or valid.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowIllegalArgumentExceptionIfPatientVoidReasonIsNull
methods.description: Tests that voiding a patient with a null reason throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowIllegalArgumentExceptionIfEncounterVoidReasonIsEmpty
methods.description: Tests that voiding an encounter with an empty reason throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: handle_shouldThrowIllegalArgumentExceptionIfObsVoidReasonIsBlank
methods.description: Tests that voiding an observation with a blank reason throws an IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfVoidReasonIsNotBlank
methods.description: Tests that voiding an observation with a non-blank reason completes without exception.

methods.name: handle_shouldNotThrowExceptionIfVoidReasonIsNullForUnsupportedTypes
methods.description: Ensures that voiding a Person with a null reason does not throw an exception for unsupported types.
